name: React Bits
summary: 200+ free animated React components (text, backgrounds, UI, micro) via shadcn/jsrepo.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free TS-TW components of ~211 TS-TW registry variants / 200+ free components on llms.txt; not a full inventory.
React Bits Pro (pro.reactbits.dev) blocks/templates/app UI/agent kit excluded — freemium; no paid unlock.
License is MIT + Commons Clause (not pure MIT SPDX) — free personal/commercial use in apps; redistribution of components as a competing library restricted. Source: LICENSE.md.
Finder gaps glass / liquid-glass / dither filled honestly via Glass Surface + Fluid Glass + Dither (free). text-scramble variants included (Scrambled Text, Decrypted Text) distinct from Fancy.
ARCHITECTURE §5 allows dynamic-import or iframe; catalog uses iframe demos (heavy WebGL/R3F/ogl) — no dynamic-import smoke mounts.
CLI identifiers are PascalCase+variant (Dither-TS-TW); docs paths are kebab-case under category folders — installOverride uses registry id; iframeSrc uses docs URL.
Also installable via full URL `npx shadcn@latest add https://reactbits.dev/r/<Component>-TS-TW` or jsrepo; catalog prefers `@react-bits/...` after registry add (README + MCP docs).
Import paths assume shadcn writes registry `path` under `@/components/...`; confirm against project aliases after CLI add.

components.name: Dither
components.summary: Retro dithered noise shader background with mouse interaction.

copyPrompt.text: Use React Bits free component `Dither` (docs slug `dither`) from https://reactbits.dev/backgrounds/dither. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @react-bits/Dither-TS-TW` after adding the `@react-bits` registry (`"@react-bits": "https://reactbits.dev/r/{name}.json"`) to `components.json` (see https://reactbits.dev/get-started/installation and https://reactbits.dev/get-started/mcp). Registry item: https://reactbits.dev/r/Dither-TS-TW.json. Prefer TypeScript + Tailwind variant (`-TS-TW`); other free variants: JS-CSS, JS-TW, TS-CSS. Import default export from `@/components/Dither/Dither` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases; registry path is `Dither/Dither.tsx`).  Requires React; install peer deps for this item as needed (three, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/postprocessing, postprocessing). Everything on reactbits.dev is free (MIT + Commons Clause — https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/LICENSE.md); do not pull React Bits Pro from pro.reactbits.dev unless the user has a Pro license. Prefer free-tier only.
